title: Isthmocele After Endometrial and Non-endometrial Suturing in Cesarean Section
brief_summary: This study compares the effect of two techniques of uterine closure, with or without endometrial suturing on isthmocele development after cesarean section.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Term pregnancy (≥37 weeks of gestation)
* Singleton pregnancy
* Primary cesarean

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous cesarean section
* Previous uterine surgery
* Multiple gestations
* Mullerian anomalies
* Active labor
* Placenta previa/accreta
